title: Extend coding agents across your team with Claude in Microsoft Foundry
description:
Many teams adopt a coding agent, then ask: why can't the rest of the org work this way? Claude Code handles engineering; Claude Cowork extends the same fundamentals to research, documents, and operational work across organizations. This talk covers how each maps to real enterprise workflows, what's happening inside the task loop, and the setup, auth, and governance patterns that matter when you run them through Microsoft Foundry. Live demos of both, pointed at work your teams already do.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
